facts.activity_file: working live under a documented justification

control_failures.control_label: integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas
application of positive isolation devices and personal locks

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: fire on SG-3100 during a breakdown response

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was medical treatment injury, with 1 person injured.

defences.finding: Control HAZARDOUS_AREA_EQUIPMENT_INTEGRITY: the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas had degraded below its design intent, and the ICAM investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control POSITIVE_ISOLATION_APPLICATION: the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Confirm at the next critical control verification that the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas on SG-3100 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in controlling access to energised apparatus, specifically working live under a documented justification. SG-3100 (switchgear and transformers) is in service for plant HV/LV distribution. The task proceeded during a breakdown response while the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas had degraded below its design intent. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 26 July 2017 an incident occurred on SG-3100 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during a breakdown response, releasing thermal energy held as hot surface.
